turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Jordan calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Brianna Shannon?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. And is your mailing address still the same?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, same address.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Give me a second while I open your file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I see the account here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $70.09.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Things are hard this month.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My statement is wrong, those amounts don't add up.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. I'll note that on the file and have it reviewed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to make a complaint about how many times you call.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To set that up I'll need a quick look at your monthly budget. What are your main expenses?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mostly rent, groceries and the car.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've noted that. The hardship team will follow up with the details.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay $70 Oct 24.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $70.09 on October 24. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How would you like to make that payment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Online banking is easiest.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That works.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before I transfer you, we can also set up a payment plan.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
